scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --filter "./packages/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.governance:test: node --test scripts/governance/check.test.mjs scripts/governance/asvs.test.mjs scripts/governance/threat-model.test.mjs scripts/governance/fuzz.test.mjs scripts/governance/perf.test.mjs scripts/governance/deps.test.mjs scripts/governance/backup.test.mjs scripts/governance/delete.test.mjs scripts/governance/test-ports.test.mjs scripts/governance/dpia.test.mjs scripts/governance/licenses.test.mjs scripts/governance/legal.test.mjs scripts/governance/wcag.test.mjs scripts/governance/release.test.mjs
